title: FOMC decision (meeting January 25-26, 2028) — the first 2028 entry this calendar would carry, named in the Board's own 2027-panel footnote
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, stamp 'Last Update: August 19, 2026') by the fomc-minutes-2027-12-29 initial-research adjacency sweep. The 2027 panel's own footnote block states it verbatim: 'Note: A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028.' 2028-01-25 is a Tuesday and 2028-01-26 a Wednesday (computed, not assumed), so the policy decision is Wednesday 2028-01-26, matching this calendar's standing convention of keying an FOMC entry to the decision day (fomc-2027-12-08 for 'December 7-8', fomc-2027-10-26 for 'October 26-27'). No SEP asterisk is attached, consistent with the January meeting in every year of the record. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: the same page states 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', which for this meeting is the December 7-8, 2027 meeting; and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The 14:00 ET statement time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-12-29 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08), at D+28 from that release -- outside the +/-5 corridor and outside +/-21, and filed anyway because THIS CALENDAR CARRIES ZERO 2028 ENTRIES and this is the Board's own dated statement of the next one. The proposer's own corridor sweep, run mechanically against all 588 tracked events and proposals, returned nothing whatsoever after 2027-12-29 -- the calendar's horizon simply stops there. IT IS ALSO THE NEAREST LIVE FED EVENT AFTER THE PROPOSER'S OWN. A December minutes release is read for what it says about the next meeting, and for the December 7-8, 2027 minutes that next meeting is this one, four weeks later; a reader of fomc-minutes-2027-12-29.md who wants the dated horizon after the release currently finds an empty calendar. THE FOOTNOTE IS ALSO A KNOWN PARSING HAZARD, recorded here so the row that exists is the safe version of it: the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 lane documented that a year-scoped parse of the 2027 panel which does not cut at the footnote block first returns this January 2028 meeting as a phantom NINTH 2027 meeting. This session cut every panel at its boundary and confirmed exactly 8 meetings per year 2007-2025. Filing the meeting as its own dated row is the durable fix for a hazard that has now been re-derived twice. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED and the impact tier is inherited, not measured: high matches every other fomc-* decision entry in this calendar. symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
